prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: unit-c-ink, single original mercenary sprite, variant C; targeted stronger ink-wash treatment.
Input images: Image 1 is our original sellsword, reference for identity, equipment, stance and camera ONLY. Do NOT retain its detailed painterly rendering.
Primary request: Radically simplify this same weary sellsword into a genuine broad-brush black ink-and-wash illustration with a powerful silhouette. Keep full body, short greying hair, stubble, padded gambeson, sword pointing down-right in right hand, round shield on left forearm, belt and separated boots, facing right. Keep the three-quarter top-down camera pitched down about 30 degrees.
Style/medium: Almost monochrome sumi-like brush ink and diluted warm-grey wash, but no imitation of any artist. BIG FLAT BLACK BRUSH MASSES, soft pooled grey washes inside the figure, broad white negative-space slashes for light, very sparse broken contour and a FEW simple quilt-seam strokes. Only three or four value families. Think a decisive loose hand-inked wash illustration, not a detailed engraving or desaturated painting. Omit small texture, scratches, rivets, hair strands, tiny crosshatching and individual stitches. The face is readable with just a few brush strokes. Shield is a simple dark disk with sparse light wash and one boss. Strong dark silhouette at small game scale; opaque silhouette, not wispy ink.
Composition/framing: One complete unit, centered square, intended for 512x512, generous margins; preserve right-facing stance and weapon angles. No paper rectangle, no ink splatter outside figure, no smoky wash beyond figure.
Scene/backdrop: Uniform solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local extraction, or isolated transparent alpha if supported. No backdrop grain, gradients, floor, contact shadow or checkerboard. Never put green in the subject.
Constraints: Entirely original, using only our own generated character as reference. No imitation of Battle Brothers, Heroes of Might and Magic, any other game, franchise or artist. No text, logos, lettering, signatures or watermarks. Produce exactly one image, change the medium aggressively while preserving identity and geometry.
